The indexed Artificial Analysis item compares Gemini 4 Hydrogen with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol on an intelligence index and relative cost. The linked social-profile cache contains an unrelated older pinned post rather than the stated comparison.

This entry therefore preserves only the feed’s claim of near-tied scores at different costs. It cannot confirm evaluation settings, price assumptions or the size and significance of the score differences.
highlights: Near-tied scores are not universal task parity
